$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
printf 'APPLICABLE_NESTED_DOCUMENTS\n'
for p in terminal/AGENTS.md terminal/README.md terminal/tasks/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/README.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/README.md; do if test -f "$p"; then printf 'FOUND_NESTED_DOC %s\n' "$p"; cat "$p"; exit 3; fi; done
SRC='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean.png'
DST='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724.png'
test -f "$SRC"
test ! -e "$DST"

python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_upper_right_quad_venv
/tmp/fishfry_upper_right_quad_venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry_upper_right_quad_venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageChops
from hashlib import sha256
src=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean.png')
dst=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724.png')
with Image.open(src) as im:
    assert im.size==(1448,1448),f'unexpected size: {im.size}'
    region=im.crop((724,0,1448,724))
assert region.size==(724,724)
region.save(dst,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
with Image.open(src) as full, Image.open(dst) as saved:
    assert saved.size==(724,724)
    assert saved.mode==region.mode
    assert ImageChops.difference(saved.convert('RGB'),full.crop((724,0,1448,724)).convert('RGB')).getbbox() is None,'output pixels differ from exact source quadrant'
print('SOURCE',src,'SOURCE_SIZE','1448x1448',flush=True)
print('QUADRANT','UPPER_RIGHT','COORDINATES','x=724..1447','y=0..723','WIDTH_HEIGHT','724x724',flush=True)
print('CROP_VERIFIED','pixel-identical to exact upper-right quadrant; no scaling or overlays',flush=True)
print('OUTPUT',dst,'BYTES',dst.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY
git add -- "$DST"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Extract upper-right quadrant of rotated fish fry screen'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
 printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
 git fetch --quiet origin main
 git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
 if git push origin HEAD:main; then
  printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
  printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
  gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$DST" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
  printf 'LOCAL_BLOB ';git hash-object "$DST"
  exit 0
 fi
done
echo 'PUBLICATION_FAILED' >&2
exit 1
